subject.title: fix(gateway): recover when suppressed channel secrets are unavailable

question: Should `secrets.reload` during crash-loop safe mode restart affected accounts that were previously running, or continue refusing automatic starts until an explicit `channels.start` request?
rationale: The central bug only requires applying existing suppression before startup SecretRef resolution, while this branch also replaces a documented operator-facing recovery policy.

options.title: Keep recovery explicit
options.body: Limit the fix to startup projection and continue requiring `channels.start` after the operator repairs the secret.

options.title: Adopt selective restarts
options.body: Approve automatic restart of previously running accounts, with exact-head proof for bounded stop, rollback, retry, and delivery behavior.

options.title: Choose the competing candidate
options.body: Pause this branch and use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106405 as the canonical startup-recovery implementation if it remains viable.

recommendation.title: Keep recovery explicit
recommendation.body: Limit the fix to startup projection and continue requiring `channels.start` after the operator repairs the secret.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the crash-loop breaker and the existing explicit-start safe-mode contract that this PR proposes to change.
